title: God's Timing is Perfectly on Time
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message of faith and trust in God's provision, as one of our members shares their incredible story of how God worked out a new job opportunity for them in a miraculous way. You'll be inspired to trust in God's timing and provision, and encouraged to keep pressing in, even when things seem uncertain. Don't miss this uplifting episode of The River Church of Kansas City's sermon podcast!
